item.omnitrix.omnitrix.tip2: Y: open the dial and pick an alien (transformed: revert)
screen.omnitrix.title: OMNITRIX
screen.omnitrix.hint: Mouse/wheel: select  •  Left click / Enter: transform  •  Right click: close
msg.omnitrix.equipped: The Omnitrix locked onto your wrist! Press Y to activate.
msg.omnitrix.not_wearing: You are not wearing the Omnitrix.
ability.omnitrix.fireball.desc: Hurls an exploding fireball (7 + 3 area damage, sets on fire).
ability.omnitrix.flamethrower.desc: Breathes a cone of fire for 1.5 seconds.
ability.omnitrix.supernova.desc: Explodes outwards: up to 15 damage within 8 blocks, burning, knockback.
ability.omnitrix.fire_jet.desc: Rocket forward and up on flames, landing in a burst of fire.
ability.omnitrix.wind_gust.desc: A gust that blows everything away and turns projectiles around.
ability.omnitrix.tornado.desc: A travelling tornado lifting and spinning enemies.
ability.omnitrix.spin_flight.desc: Spin up into the air and glide (6 s).
ability.omnitrix.shell_slam.desc: Leap and crash down shell first: area damage.
ability.omnitrix.crystal_blades.desc: Arms become crystal blades for 15 s: +6 damage and sweep.
ability.omnitrix.spike_wave.desc: Crystal spikes erupt from the ground ahead (9 damage, launch).
ability.omnitrix.crystal_prison.desc: Encases the target in crystal for 4 s.
ability.omnitrix.acid_spit.desc: Corrosive acid that also eats armour (5 damage + poison).
ability.omnitrix.stretch_grab.desc: Your arm stretches out, grabs the target and pulls it in.
ability.omnitrix.puddle.desc: Become a puddle for 5 s: immune to melee, poisons whoever touches you, splashes back up.
ability.omnitrix.acid_bomb.desc: A lobbed bomb leaving a pool of acid for 4 s.
ability.omnitrix.speed_dash.desc: Dash up to 14 blocks at lightning speed, ramming everything.
ability.omnitrix.blitz.desc: 8 lightning fast hits while circling the target.
ability.omnitrix.vortex_run.desc: Run in circles to create a vortex that flings enemies.
ability.omnitrix.overdrive.desc: Speed V and Haste III for 12 s.
ability.omnitrix.thunder_clap.desc: A four handed clap: 9 damage, stun and knockback ahead.
ability.omnitrix.ground_pound.desc: Leap and slam down: a 6.5 block shockwave.
ability.omnitrix.quad_combo.desc: A punch from every arm, the last one launches.
ability.omnitrix.boulder_throw.desc: Rip the block in front of you out and throw it (11 area damage).
ability.omnitrix.freeze_breath.desc: Freezes everything ahead and turns water to ice.
ability.omnitrix.phase.desc: Invisible and untouchable for 4 s; enemies lose you.
ability.omnitrix.ice_prison.desc: Encases the target in ice for 4 s.
ability.omnitrix.ice_flight.desc: Spread your wings and fly for 12 s.
ability.omnitrix.sonic_discs.desc: 3 homing discs that stick to enemies and vibrate.
ability.omnitrix.sonic_doom.desc: Surround the target with discs for a huge sonic blast (22 damage).
ability.omnitrix.sonic_scream.desc: A deafening scream in a cone; shatters glass.
ability.omnitrix.disc_ride.desc: Fly on your discs for 10 s.
ability.omnitrix.intangible.desc: Invisible, untouchable and flying for 5 s.
ability.omnitrix.possess.desc: Enter a monster and make it fight other monsters for 15 s.
ability.omnitrix.tentacles.desc: Tentacles from your chest grab and pull 4 enemies.
ability.omnitrix.terror.desc: A dark wave that blinds enemies and sends them fleeing.
passive.omnitrix.heatblast: Passive: fire/lava immune, punches ignite; weakened in water. Block: flame shield.
passive.omnitrix.terraspin: Passive: no fall damage, glides while sneaking. Block: retreat into the shell.
passive.omnitrix.diamondhead: Passive: resistance, reflects 25% of projectiles. Block: crystal shield (reflects).
passive.omnitrix.goop: Passive: no fall damage, poison immune; punches poison. Block: projectiles pass through.
passive.omnitrix.xlr8: Passive: speed, step assist, runs on water. Block: evasion (75%).
passive.omnitrix.fourarms: Passive: super strength, high jump, knockback resistant. Block: four armed guard.
passive.omnitrix.bigchill: Passive: freezes water as he walks, punches freeze. Block: ice wall.
passive.omnitrix.ultimate_echo_echo: Passive: echolocation shows nearby monsters. Block: sound barrier (reflects).
passive.omnitrix.ghostfreak: Passive: night vision, slow fall, punches wither. Block: melee passes through.
